name: Ghost Smasher
body:
Price 48,380 gp; Aura faint divination; CL 6th; Weight 14 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This amazing +2 cold iron ghost touch undead bane earthbreaker is coated in fine layers of red and white enamel with silver inlay. Whenever it is within the presence of undead (60 ft.), the hammer begins to emit an eerie tune and a magical blue flame lights up and rotates around the massive spiked head, this flame has no heat and does not burn anything, but its light illuminates and reveals the location of any undead in the area, including ones that are invisible.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 24,230 gp; Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells dancing lights, detect undead, faerie fire, ghost sound, plane shift, summon monster I
